title: Saying "I am still here"
note: This is a stream, not a plain request: `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, one JSON object per line, and every one of them wrapped in `result`. A client that writes several ids down this one body gets one answer per id.

title: Renewing a lease that is already gone
note: No error, and no TTL field: zero is the default, so it is left out. A client renewing in a loop sees TTL 0 and knows its keys are gone, without having to tell an error apart from a network failure.
